speaker: Doctor
text: I notice you mentioned gait and limb ataxia, but I need more details to proceed. Can you describe exactly what happens when you try to walk or touch your nose with your finger? Also, do you have a history of diabetes, since this is often associated with these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Multiple Sclerosis (MS) with cerebellar involvement.
